resource: Creature thinks started in one 50 ms window of one Channel
allocation_impact: A per-Channel counter reset each 50 ms window; due thinks beyond it stay due in the creature table (one pending think per creature) and start in the next window in deadline order then ExactActorRef. It reserves nothing; a wake of idle creatures by one player move is capped at the same 1,024.
boundary_tests: max=1024: 1,024 due thinks start in one window
max+1=1025: the 1,025th stays due and starts first in the next window
consumers: apps/game-server/src/gameplay_transport/monster_ai_cycle.rs next_monster_ai_pass_us: a pass leaving due thinks schedules the next pass in the next window
notes: CREATURE-AI-1 §1.3 and §2.1. Test: apps/game-server/src/ai_think/think_tests.rs thinks_per_window_at_max_start_now_and_the_rest_next_window. Registered by OTV2-20261004-creature-ai-1. SPAWN-CEILINGS-1 (Codex 4243189401): the Channel owner's monster AI pass runs again at the start of the next window while thinks remain due (not one 1 s think interval later), and only one pass per interval swings; tests: monster_ai_cycle.rs a_think_backlog_resumes_in_the_next_owner_window_and_swings_keep_their_interval, foundation/channel_owner_creature_ai_tests.rs thinks_past_the_window_budget_stay_due_and_run_in_the_next_window. SPAWN-CEILINGS-1 (Codex 4243397472): the owner selects a window's thinks with a heap bounded by the remaining budget (no collect and sort of every due think) and takes the next pass time from that selection; a backlog pass between swing passes skips the creature census, admission, forget and wake and reuses the last swing pass's player set with fresh positions; tests: foundation/channel_owner_creature_ai_tests.rs the_bounded_think_selection_equals_the_full_sort_and_reports_the_next_think, gameplay_transport/monster_ai_cycle.rs a_think_backlog_resumes_in_the_next_owner_window_and_swings_keep_their_interval.
